name: anlide/hilos-demo-chat
description: Real-time chat with WebSocket and enhanced capabilities demo project for Hilos v2 framework

scripts.hilos-frontend-reminder: @php -r "echo PHP_EOL . 'Hilos frontend: run npm install in the frontend container after composer changes, so the vendored SDK is not stale - see framework/frontend/README.md.' . PHP_EOL;"
scripts.setup-env: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local sh -c "if [ ! -f ../.env ] && [ -f ../.env.example ]; then cp ../.env.example ../.env && echo '.env file created from .env.example'; else echo '.env file already exists or .env.example not found'; fi"
scripts.install-deps: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local composer install
scripts.daemon-status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:status
scripts.daemon-monitor: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php daemon:monitor
scripts.cli: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php
scripts.db:migration:up: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:up
scripts.db:migration:down: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:down
scripts.db:migration:status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:status
scripts.db:migration:retry: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:migration:retry
scripts.db:seed:apply: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:seed:apply
scripts.db:schema:status: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml run --rm chat-cli-local php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:schema:status
scripts.pma: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml up -d phpmyadmin-local && echo phpMyAdmin is running at http://localhost:8080
scripts.frontend:install: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-local npm install
scripts.frontend:check: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-local npm run check
scripts.frontend:lint: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-local npm run lint
scripts.frontend:format-check: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-local npm run format:check
scripts.frontend:build: docker-compose -f docker/docker-compose.local.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-local npm run build
scripts.test:install-deps: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test composer update phpunit/phpunit --no-interaction
scripts.test:db-reset: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:test:reset
scripts.test:db-wait: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php db:wait
scripts.test:e2e-seed-orphan: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:orphan:create e2e_orphan_delete string seed-value
scripts.test:e2e-seed-users: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php backend/Bootstrap/cli.php test:user:seed 25
scripts.test:unit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite unit
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml --testsuite integration
scripts.test:phpunit: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-cli-test php vendor/bin/phpunit -c tests/phpunit.xml
scripts.test:check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-test sh -c "npm install && npm run check"
scripts.test:e2e-build: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile cli run --rm chat-frontend-cli-test sh -c "npm install && npm run build"
scripts.test:e2e-install: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm chat-e2e-runner npm install
scripts.test:e2e-check: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm chat-e2e-runner npm run check
scripts.test:e2e-up: composer run test:up && composer run test:db-wait && composer run test:db-reset && composer run test:e2e-seed-orphan && composer run test:e2e-seed-users && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e up -d --build chat-test chat-nginx-test
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --profile e2e run --rm chat-e2e-runner npx playwright test
scripts.test:e2e-full: composer run test:e2e-build && composer run test:e2e-install && composer run test:e2e-check && composer run test:e2e-up && composer run test:e2e && composer run test:e2e-down
scripts.test:all: composer run test:db-reset && composer run test:phpunit && composer run test:down && composer run test:e2e-full
